answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25496 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to ask if a person having fast and he got discharged due to wet dream in the afternoon. then he still is with the fast or his fast is void? Question: Aslam-o-Alikum, i want to ask if a person having fast and he got discharged due to wet dream in the afternoon. then he still is with the fast or his fast is void. JAZAK ALLAH KHAIR Answer ID: 25496 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1870/1352/H=1431) It neither invalidates the fast nor makes it makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
